subject: general
question: Madhav starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 12 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km, takes a left turn and drives 4 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
The Logic follows here is:

1) Madhav starts from** Point A and drives 16 km towards the east**.

2) He then takes a** right turn, drives 4 km,** turns **right and drives 12 km.**

3) He then takes a** right turn and drives 11 km,**

4) takes a **left turn and drives 4 km **and **stops at Point B.** 

Drawing the Diagram as per the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c9d982e298e7fa2366ee899d618201fd90d2c317a04600e2d54a79956361cc1.png] 

Distance between point B to point A is 7KM.

Thus, Madhav should drive **7KM in south direction to reach point A from Point B.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1"**
